summary: Iter147 — Hair Colour Try-On extensions (custom salon shades, AI 'See it on me' preview, redesigned poster, colour→booking hand-off). Backend pytest: 12/13 pass. One real product bug: DELETE /api/hair-colors/custom/{id} returns 200 on the second call instead of 404 because delete_custom_shade filters by {tenant_id,id} without excluding already-inactive rows, so it re-soft-deletes. Preview endpoint validated end-to-end (small selfie → 400, unknown colour → 404, one real Gemini call returned front + back within ~30 s). Poster is 1080x1620 PNG > 300 KB with the blurred shade-photo backdrop, gold frame, swatch ribbon. Frontend admin flow: poster preview image loads (naturalWidth=1080), no layout overflow (right panel scrollWidth==clientWidth==506), builder opens → save shows 'Shade added' toast → thumbnail carries color-custom-remove-<id>, click → 'Shade removed' toast. Public flow (430x900): 20 cards (18 catalogue + 2 residual customs) → color-see-on-me hidden when camera skipped → submit 'QA Flow' → done screen with code → color-book-btn lands on /book/miracurl-marathahalli?color=rose-brown&code=<c> with book-color-banner showing 'Rose Brown' → book-color-continue advances without crash. Regression: /book/{slug} desktop 1280 without params shows book-color-link (data-testid), no banner. Other settings cards still render.

minor.issue: Second DELETE on an already soft-deleted shade returns 200 instead of the spec-required 404. Root cause: routes/hair_colors.py delete_custom_shade filters by {tenant_id, id} only, so update_one matches the doc where active is already False and returns matched_count=1. Fix: change filter to {tenant_id: t['id'], 'id': color_id, 'active': {'$ne': False}} — same pattern already used in _lookup and _catalog_with_images.

action_items: Fix DELETE /api/hair-colors/custom/{id} idempotency — add `active: {'$ne': False}` to the delete_custom_shade filter so re-delete returns 404 (per spec).

Improve pytest cleanup / dev seed to hard-delete residual custom shades left over from previous iterations — the tenant currently has ~7 stale custom rows (20 total shades vs 18 catalogue) that all show trash icons in the admin strip.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/hair_colors.py delete_custom_shade: soft-delete filter must exclude already-inactive rows or DELETE is not idempotent 404. Currently second call succeeds silently.

backend/routes/hair_colors.py public_color_preview: no rate-limit on a 150 s Gemini image edit that costs credits — any anonymous visitor can spam POST /api/public/color/{slug}/preview. Add per-IP or per-slug throttle (e.g. 3 req / 5 min) and reject payloads > 2 MB before hitting Gemini.

backend/routes/hair_colors.py add_custom_shade: swatch normalisation pads to length 3 by repeating the last colour — for a single-colour shade this gives a flat gradient. Consider interpolating a lighter/darker end so the preview swatch reads as a real gradient.

backend/routes/hair_colors.py _paint_custom failure path: sets image_error but front-end has no surface for that; a shade that failed to paint sits forever with a spinner in the admin strip. Add a small ⚠️ badge with the error text on hover.

frontend/src/components/settings/ColorTryOnCard.jsx: reads slug from localStorage.getItem('miracurl_tenant') — same fragile pattern noted in iter146. If admin lands on /settings before tenant context is set the poster link goes to '/color/'. Prefer AuthContext / useTenant().

frontend/src/components/settings/ColorTryOnCard.jsx addShade: setTimeout(loadColors, 35000) re-fetches after 35 s to pick up the painted image, but if the tenant navigates away the timer keeps running & setState-on-unmounted may warn. Clear the timeout in useEffect cleanup or on unmount.

frontend/src/pages/ColorTryOn.jsx seeItOnMe: single-flight — if user taps twice the second axios call fires (previewBusy check happens after setPreviewBusy). Move the guard to the start of the function.

rca_of_the_issue: DELETE /api/hair-colors/custom/{id} idempotency bug: routes/hair_colors.py:169 uses `update_one({'tenant_id': t['id'], 'id': color_id}, {'$set': {'active': False}})` which matches even already-inactive rows. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/hair-colors/custom … → 200 (2) DELETE /api/hair-colors/custom/<id> → 200 ok:true (3) DELETE /api/hair-colors/custom/<id> again → 200 (expected 404). Mitigation: add `'active': {'$ne': False}` to the filter so matched_count is 0 on the second call and the existing HTTPException(404) branch fires.
